steps: Mean: add all values, divide by how many.

method_card.title: Averages & Spread
method_card.content:
Mean = sum ÷ count. Median = middle value when ordered. Mode = most frequent. Range = largest − smallest.

Frequency table: mean = \(\frac{\sum fx}{\sum f}\). Grouped data: use class midpoints, so the mean is an estimate; the modal class has the highest frequency and the median class holds the \(\frac{n}{2}\)th value.

steps: Estimated mean from grouped data: Σ(f × midpoint) ÷ Σf, and state that it is an estimate.
Changing every value: adding k shifts the mean by k but leaves the range unchanged; multiplying by k scales both the mean and the range by k.
Missing frequency: write Σfx and Σf using the unknown, set the mean equal to the given value, then solve.
